title: Among customers who use EUR currency and have made at least one transaction
question: Among customers who use EUR currency and have made at least one transaction before noon, what percentage belong to the 'LAM' segment and have recorded a monthly consumption greater than 500 in any month?

arguments.sql:
WITH eligible AS (
    SELECT c."XCL_001" AS cid, c."XCL_002" AS seg
    FROM customers AS c
    WHERE c."XCL_003" = 'EUR'
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM transactions_1k AS t
          WHERE t."XCL_013" = c."XCL_001"
            AND t."XCL_012" < '12:00:00'
      )
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM yearmonth AS ym
          WHERE ym."XCL_019" = c."XCL_001"
            AND ym."XCL_021" > 500
      )
)
SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN seg = 'LAM' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(*) AS percentage
FROM eligible

WITH eligible AS (
    SELECT c."XCL_001" AS cid, c."XCL_002" AS seg
    FROM customers AS c
    WHERE c."XCL_003" = 'EUR'
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM transactions_1k AS t
          WHERE t."XCL_013" = c."XCL_001"
            AND t."XCL_012" < '12:00:00'
      )
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM yearmonth AS ym
          WHERE ym."XCL_019" = c."XCL_001"
            AND ym."XCL_021" > 500
      )
)
SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN seg = 'LAM' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(*) AS percentage
FROM eligible

entity_grain_realization.pre_realization_sql:
WITH eligible AS (
    SELECT c."XCL_001" AS cid, c."XCL_002" AS seg
    FROM customers AS c
    WHERE c."XCL_003" = 'EUR'
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM transactions_1k AS t
          WHERE t."XCL_013" = c."XCL_001"
            AND t."XCL_012" < '12:00:00'
      )
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM yearmonth AS ym
          WHERE ym."XCL_019" = c."XCL_001"
            AND ym."XCL_021" > 500
      )
)
SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN seg = 'LAM' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(*) AS percentage
FROM eligible

WITH base AS (
    SELECT c."XCL_001" AS cid, c."XCL_002" AS seg
    FROM customers c
    WHERE c."XCL_003" = 'EUR'
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM transactions_1k t
          WHERE t."XCL_013" = c."XCL_001"
            AND t."XCL_012" < '12:00:00'
      )
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM yearmonth ym
          WHERE ym."XCL_019" = c."XCL_001"
            AND ym."XCL_021" > 500
      )
)
SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN seg = 'LAM' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(*) AS percentage
FROM base
